app.name: Doar Mail
welcome.title: Welcome to Doar Mail
welcome.lead: Simple mail for all your accounts. Start by adding an email account.
welcome.privacy: Doar Mail sends no usage data. Your mail stays on your server and on this computer.
list.empty: There are no messages in this folder.
status.coreError: The app core is not responding. Try restarting the app.
about.detail: A simple email client. MIT license. Doar Mail sends no usage data.
wizard.title: Add account
wizard.lead: Enter your name, email address and password.
wizard.name: Your name
wizard.name.hint: Shown to the recipients of your messages.
wizard.discoveryNote: Settings are looked up by your address's domain: first on your domain's own servers, then in the Mozilla Thunderbird settings database. Your password is not sent anywhere.
wizard.found: We found these settings. Check them and continue.
wizard.guessed: We guessed these settings from common conventions. Please check them.
wizard.notFound: The settings could not be found automatically. Please enter them manually – your mail or hosting provider lists them.
wizard.saveSentCopy: Save a copy of sent messages to the Sent folder
wizard.saveSentCopy.hint: Turn off if your provider saves sent mail by itself – otherwise you get duplicate copies.
wizard.appPassword: Gmail requires an app password, not your regular password. Create one in your Google account settings (2-step verification required).
wizard.oauthUnsupported: This provider (e.g. Outlook.com) requires Microsoft sign-in, which Doar does not support yet.
wizard.secureStorageMissing: Your system has no secure password storage. We can keep the password only until the app closes – you will enter it again next time.
errors.HOST_NOT_FOUND: Server not found. Check its name.
errors.CONNECTION_REFUSED: The server refused the connection. Check the port and security.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server is not responding. Check your internet connection, the server name and the port.
errors.CERT_UNTRUSTED: The server certificate is not trusted. The connection would not be secure, so Doar will not use it.
errors.CERT_EXPIRED: The server certificate has expired. Contact your provider.
errors.CERT_HOSTNAME: The server certificate belongs to a different server name.
errors.TLS_FAILED: The secure connection failed. Try a different security setting (SSL/TLS or STARTTLS) or port.
errors.STARTTLS_UNSUPPORTED: The server does not support STARTTLS. Try SSL/TLS (port 993 for IMAP, 465 for SMTP).
errors.PROTOCOL: The server responded unexpectedly. Check the port and security.
errors.UNKNOWN: The connection failed for an unknown reason.
errors.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This account has already been added to Doar.
wizard.certValidFor: The certificate is valid for: {names}. If there is no server button here, ask your hosting provider for the correct server name.
folders.label: Folders
list.label: Message list
list.pending: Change is waiting to be saved to the server
list.failed: The change could not be saved to the server
reader.label: Message
reader.remoteBlocked: Remote images are blocked so the sender cannot tell when you opened the message.
reader.unavailable: The message content has not been downloaded yet and the server is not reachable.
errors.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Password missing. Add the account again.
errors.BODY_UNAVAILABLE: The message content has not been downloaded yet and the server is not reachable.
compose.subject: Subject
compose.noSubject: Send the message without a subject?
compose.plainOnly: Your message is saved to Drafts as you type.
errors.REJECTED: The server rejected the message (for example, a recipient does not exist).
errors.INTERRUPTED: The app was closed while sending.
outbox.uncertain: It is not certain whether “{subject}” was sent. The connection dropped exactly while sending and the message is not in the Sent folder – the server may have accepted it.
outbox.copyFailed: “{subject}” was sent, but the copy could not be saved to the Sent folder.
outbox.label: Sending
backup.title: Back up account
backup.lead: The backup saves all mail of the account from all folders into a single .mbox file. Messages that are not on this computer yet are downloaded from the server first.
backup.warnPlain: The backup is not encrypted – it contains readable mail. Keep it in a safe place.
backup.noEmptyFolders: Empty folders are not restored from a backup – the file contains only messages.
backup.noSecrets: Passwords are not part of the backup.
backup.cancelConfirm: Really cancel the backup? The unfinished file will be deleted.
backup.result.incomplete: Incomplete backup – some messages are missing. The file name contains “-NEUPLNA” so it is not mistaken for a complete backup.
backup.result.cancelled: The backup was cancelled. No file was created.
backup.result.failed: The backup failed: {reason} No file was created.
backup.unavailableHint: Unavailable = messages someone deleted on the server during the backup.
backup.gmail: Gmail: each message is in the backup only once (from All Mail), with its labels stored alongside.
errors.DISK_FULL: There is not enough space on the disk.
errors.WRITE_FAILED: The file could not be written.
errors.PATH_NOT_ALLOWED: Choose the file in the dialog.
errors.EXPORT_RUNNING: A backup of this account is already running.
actions.tooLate: It can no longer be undone – the move has already been made on the server.
actions.confirmForeverOne: Permanently delete this message? It will be removed from the server and cannot be recovered.
actions.confirmForeverMany: Permanently delete {n} selected messages? They will be removed from the server and cannot be recovered.
folderDialog.name: Folder name
errors.FOLDER_EXISTS: A folder with this name already exists here.
errors.INVALID_FOLDER_NAME: The folder name is not valid – it is empty, too long or contains a character the server does not allow (such as / or %).
errors.CROSS_ACCOUNT: Messages can only be moved within one account.
errors.NO_TARGET: The target folder does not exist.
compose.attachmentsBig: Some servers reject messages larger than 20–25 MB.
compose.dropSkipped: Some items cannot be attached (folders, for example).
attachments.openBlocked: Open – not possible (the file could run as a program)
attachments.noApp: “{name}” could not be opened – there is probably no program for it. Save it and open it manually.
errors.DANGEROUS_ATTACHMENT: This file could run as a program. Doar will not open it – if you trust it, save it and open it yourself.
errors.ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE: The attachments are larger than 50 MB in total – the server would not accept such a message.
errors.ATTACHMENT_MISSING: An attached file was not found (it may have been moved or deleted): {name}
errors.WRITE_DENIED: This location is not writable. Choose another folder.
compose.discardConfirm: Discard this message? The draft will also be deleted from the server.
compose.draftFailed: The draft could not be saved
compose.closeUnsaved: The draft could not be saved. Close the window anyway? Unsaved changes will be lost.
search.label: Search mail
search.tip: Searches subjects, addresses and message text, ignoring accents (Ctrl+E). Tips: from:john  to:eve  subject:invoice  "exact phrase"
search.incomplete: The text of {n} messages has not been downloaded yet – only their subjects and addresses are searched for now.
notify.title: New mail – {account}
settings.title: Settings
ai.mayErr: AI can make mistakes – please check.
ai.truncated: The text was too long – AI received or returned only part of it.
ai.summary.title: Summary
ai.summary.confirm: Summarize the message with AI? The text of this message (without attachments) will be sent to: {target}.
ai.compose.buttonTitle: Reply suggestion and text edits with AI
ai.compose.title: Writing help (AI)
ai.compose.instruction: Your own instruction, e.g. “add a thank-you”
ai.compose.sendsReply: A reply suggestion also sends the original message text (without attachments).
ai.compose.noText: First write or select the text to edit.
ai.compose.changed: The text changed in the meantime – the suggestion was not inserted. Copy it manually or try again.
ai.settings.title: AI (optional)
ai.settings.enableHint: Message summary, reply suggestions and writing help. Doar Mail works exactly the same without AI.
ai.settings.hint.anthropic: Claude models from Anthropic. You need your own API key (pay per use).
ai.settings.hint.openrouter: One key for models from many companies. You need your own API key.
ai.settings.hint.local: The model runs on your computer or home network (Ollama, LM Studio…) – your mail never leaves your network.
ai.settings.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or http://localhost:1234/v1 (LM Studio).
ai.settings.keySecure: The key is stored in the system's secure storage.
ai.settings.keySession: The key is kept only until the app closes (no encrypted system storage).
ai.settings.modelsOkNoKey: Model list loaded ({n}). The key is checked on first use.
ai.settings.privacyNote: Content is sent to the chosen provider only when you click an AI button, and it always says what is sent and where. Attachments are never sent. AI never sends, deletes or moves anything on its own – its text is only a suggestion.
errors.AI_INSECURE_URL: Unencrypted connections (http) are allowed only to this computer or your home network. Otherwise use https.
errors.AI_AUTH: The API key is not valid.
errors.AI_CREDIT: Not enough credit on your AI provider account.
errors.AI_FORBIDDEN: The AI provider refused the request.
errors.AI_MODEL: Model not found – check its name in AI settings.
errors.AI_TOO_LONG: The text is too long for the AI.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests – try again in a moment.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is overloaded or unavailable right now.
errors.AI_BAD_REQUEST: The AI provider did not accept the request.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI provider is not responding.
errors.AI_NO_CONNECTION: Could not connect to the AI server. Is the local server running, or are you online?
errors.AI_BAD_KEY: The API key has an invalid format.
errors.AI_NO_KEY: API key missing – enter it in Settings → AI.
errors.AI_NO_MODEL: No model selected – choose one in Settings → AI.
errors.AI_NO_INSTRUCTION: Write an instruction for the AI.
errors.AI_NO_MESSAGE: The message being replied to is missing.
errors.AI_DISABLED: AI is turned off – turn it on in Settings → AI.
errors.AI_BUSY: AI is busy – wait for the result.
account.displayNameHint: Recipients see it on your messages.
account.name: Account name
account.nameHint: Shown next to messages in the unified inbox.
account.signatureHint: Added at the end of new messages and above the quoted text in replies.
account.serverHint: Change only if your provider changed the server or your password.
account.newPasswordHint: Leave empty if the password has not changed.
account.serverFailed: Settings were not saved – the server did not accept them.
account.removeConfirm:
Remove account {email} from Doar?

Mail on the server stays untouched. The local copy on this computer, drafts stored only here and the account settings will be deleted.
account.removePending: Note: {n} messages are still waiting to be sent – they will not be sent after the account is removed.
account.removed: Account {email} was removed from Doar. Mail on the server is untouched.
account.sessionPassword: The password of this account is kept only until the app is closed.
general.notifyShowContent: Show sender and subject in the notification
general.notifyShowContentHint: Turn off if you do not want message details shown, e.g. on the lock screen.
errors.INVALID_NAME: The account name must not be empty.
errors.INVALID_IMAP: Check the incoming mail server and port.
errors.INVALID_SMTP: Check the outgoing mail server and port.
editor.heading: Heading
compose.formatTitle: Switch between a formatted message and plain text
compose.toPlainConfirm: Switch to plain text? Formatting (bold, lists, links…) will be lost.
general.composeHtmlHint: A formatted message is also sent as plain text, so every program can read it.
print.subject: Subject
outbox.waitingNetwork: “{subject}” is waiting for a connection – it will be sent automatically once the server is reachable.
outbox.cancelConfirm: Do not send “{subject}”? It will be discarded.
list.notDownloaded: Content not downloaded to this computer yet
compose.draftSavedLocal: Draft saved on this computer {time} – it will be uploaded once connected
errors.NO_NETWORK: This computer is not connected to a network.
errors.OFFLINE: The server is not reachable – it will be retried.
restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.lead: Messages from the .mbox file are uploaded to the chosen account on the server. A Doar backup also restores folders, dates, read state and stars.
restore.foreign: mbox file from another program – no folders, messages go to one folder
restore.modeRestore: Into the original folders (missing ones are created)
restore.restoreHint: Inbox, Sent, Trash and others are matched by their role, even if this server names them differently.
restore.noOverwrite: Existing mail on the server is never overwritten or deleted.
restore.noDuplicates: Messages already in a folder are not uploaded again – the restore can be safely repeated.
restore.cancelConfirm: Stop the restore? Messages uploaded so far stay on the server and you can continue later.
restore.step.check: Looking for messages already on the server
restore.discardConfirm: Forget this restore? Messages already on the server will stay there.
restore.result.partial: Restore finished, but the server rejected {n} messages
restore.result.cancelled: The restore was stopped. Messages uploaded so far stayed on the server – you can continue.
restore.quotaHint: The mailbox on the server is full. Free up space (e.g. empty Trash or delete large messages) and click Continue – only the remaining {n} messages will be uploaded.
restore.resumeHint: {n} messages remain. Click Continue – nothing is uploaded twice.
restore.duplicateHint: “Already there” = the message is already in that folder on the server (e.g. a repeated restore), so it was not uploaded again.
restore.changedOutside: {n} messages in the file were modified by another program – they were restored as they are in the file.
restore.foreignHint: {n} messages had no Doar metadata – they are in the import folder.
restore.keywordsDropped: The server does not support custom tags – {n} messages were restored without them (read state and stars were kept).
restore.skipped: {n} empty or unreadable entries in the file were skipped.
errors.NOT_MBOX: The file is not in mbox format.
errors.FILE_MISSING: The backup file was not found. If it is on a removable drive, connect it.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: The backup file has changed in the meantime. Start the restore again – messages already on the server will not be duplicated.
errors.OVERQUOTA: The mailbox on the server is full.
errors.TOO_BIG: the message is too large for the server
errors.LIMIT: the server rejected the message due to its limits
errors.APP_CLOSED: The application was closed during the restore.
errors.FOLDER_CREATE_FAILED: The server did not create the folder.
errors.NO_CONNECTION: The connection to the server was interrupted.
archive.label: Archive
archive.closeConfirm: Close the archive “{name}”? The file stays on disk unchanged – only its message list is removed from Doar.
archive.missing: The archive file was not found (moved or a disconnected drive).
archive.readOnlyHint: This message is from an archive file. You can read, print, save attachments, reply and forward – the file is never changed.
errors.ARCHIVE_FILE_MISSING: The archive file was not found. If it is on a removable drive, connect it.
errors.ARCHIVE_CHANGED: The archive file has changed – loading it again.
errors.MOVE_IN_PROGRESS: The message is being moved on the server right now – try again in a moment.
update.ready: Doar Mail {version} is ready. It starts after a restart – your mail, accounts and drafts stay.
general.updatesPrivacy: Doar Mail only asks GitHub for the latest release – it sends no data about you. Nothing is downloaded without your consent.
errors.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Could not find out whether a new version is available.
errors.UPDATE_BAD_MANIFEST: The update description on GitHub is invalid.
errors.UPDATE_BAD_FILE: The downloaded file is damaged or incomplete – try again.
errors.UPDATE_NOT_WRITABLE: The program folder is not writable. Move Doar Mail to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs.
errors.UPDATE_DEV: Only an installed Doar Mail can be updated (not during development).
wizard.passwordHint: For Outlook.com, Hotmail and Gmail you can leave it empty – you sign in with Microsoft or Google.
oauth.intro.microsoft: Outlook.com, Hotmail and Microsoft 365 are added by signing in with your Microsoft account. You enter your password directly with Microsoft – Doar Mail never sees it.
oauth.intro.google: The easiest way is to sign in with your Google account. You enter your password directly with Google – Doar Mail never sees it.
oauth.orAppPassword: Or use a Google app password (below) and click Verify and save.
oauth.waiting: Finish signing in in the browser that opened…
oauth.page.title: Doar Mail
oauth.page.done: You are signed in. You can close this window and return to Doar Mail.
oauth.page.failed: Sign-in failed. Return to Doar Mail and try again.
account.oauthVia: Signed in with {provider} – no password is stored.
errors.OAUTH_EXPIRED: The sign-in with your provider account has expired – sign in again in the account settings.
errors.OAUTH_TIMEOUT: Sign-in was not completed in time – please try again.
errors.OAUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sign-in with this provider is not available in this version of Doar Mail.
errors.OAUTH_WRONG_ACCOUNT: You signed in with a different account than this one.
